en.answer: Even if a given "Cloudian" monster was Special Summoned by <<7649>>, you can activate <<5432>> by targeting it. However, if you do, that monster will not be changed to face-down Defense Position. (It will remain in its current battle position.)
en.question: If a "Cloudian" monster has been Special Summoned by <<7649>>, can I activate <<5432>> by targeting it?
en.title: If a monster has been Special Summoned by <<7649>>, can I activate <<5432>> by targeting it?

ja.answer:
「<<7649>>」の効果によって特殊召喚されている「雲魔物」と名のついたモンスターを対象に「<<5432>>」を発動する事はできます。
しかしながら、裏側守備表示にする処理は適用されず、「雲魔物」と名のついたモンスターの表示形式は変わりません。
